data.name: Gish
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'gisthai', meaning 'to laugh' or 'to be jested'. In ancient Greece, the 'Gish' was a jester or fool who entertained and brought joy to others. The name also carries a deeper meaning, referencing the wise and knowing nature of a jester, who often had unique insights and perspectives.
